_: Alignment of two independent open codings (A: 16 emergent categories; B: 20) to the FIXED ten places of qc_vocabulary_v2. Adversarial policy for part (2): a category 'maps to' a place only if that place, as glossed in the vocabulary's own tie-break rules, would BY ITSELF pick out the same grouping; COMBINATION if two or three places jointly do the selecting; NONE when a residue of the selecting handle is named by no place. Note on 'modality': the vocabulary lists it without a gloss, unlike the other nine. Read as deontic mode it duplicates character_force; read as output channel it partially absorbs the deployment_surface candidate below. It is used in no alignment here, and that ambiguity is itself a finding.

cross_coder.method: Two categories are paired when their id-lists overlap on the grouping's core members AND their descriptions name the same selecting handle. Overlap counts are stated per pair; a pair can be 'partial' where one coder splits or absorbs members the other keeps together.

pairs.a: Surface form and delivery of the output
pairs.note: Both key on packaging (markup, length, prosody, consumer type). B additionally pulls no-repetition and handle-interruptions in here; A files those under dialogue mechanics.
B fragments A's grouping four ways: coherence/topicality stays in B2, redundancy and interruption go to B1, responsiveness and elicitation go to B3, the mic-check ritual goes to B17.

pairs.a: Forbidden content categories keyed to subject matter
pairs.note: A treats every named content bucket as one family; B splits it, sending weapons/substances/criminal-planning/u04 to the uplift category, suicide to user-wellbeing, and violence-and-hate to misfits. The disagreement is about whether a bucket selects by what the material depicts or by what it enables.

pairs.a: Causal contribution to real-world harmful capability
pairs.b: Operational contribution to a harmful act
pairs.note: B's version is broader by absorbing three llamaguard buckets and u04; A moves the self-harm items (u07, do-not-encourage-self-harm) here, B moves them to user-wellbeing.

pairs.a: Hostile or demeaning expression toward persons and groups
pairs.b: Offensiveness of the language toward persons or groups

pairs.a: Truth relation between what is said and how things are
Claims the system makes about what it itself is
pairs.b: Claims about the assistant's own nature
pairs.note: B adds p11 (persistent personal identity), which A files under attributed motivations.

pairs.a: Information flow and entitlement to data
pairs.b: Someone else's claim over information or work

pairs.note: A adds hhh:harmless-3 (stakes of advice); B files that under rules-about-rules.

pairs.a: Relational stance toward the user as a person
pairs.note: A's category is a superset of four B categories: B14 (bond), B13 (what may be said about the user), B15 (wellbeing/autonomy), B16 (sycophancy). Paired to B14 as the nearest single counterpart.

pairs.b: Standing toward human oversight and instruction authority
pairs.note: B additionally reads undermine-oversight as an authority-relation item; A files it with agentic action.

pairs.a: Second-order rules about how other rules are applied
pairs.b: Rules whose subject matter is other rules
pairs.note: A includes objectivity here; B pairs objectivity with sycophancy instead. B includes hhh:harmless-3 here; A puts it with the licensure domains.
B's version additionally absorbs be-receptive and helpful-2 out of A's dialogue-mechanics grouping.

Same three ids at the core (third-party-harm, general-harm, p03) but different rationales: A says the handle is the identity of the cost-bearer, B says the handle is the absence of any operationalization. Both diagnoses are separately defensible and both are unlisted places.

pairs.a: Agentic action, side effects, and oversight
pairs.note: B's category is a singleton; the oversight half of A's category went to B7.

pairs.a: Attributed motivations and character of the model
pairs.b: Motive and disposition read off the response
pairs.note: A fuses inferred motive (p07-p10, p12) with displayed character traits (be-warm, be-curious, be-creative); B separates them into B6 and B17, and sends p06 to value-primitives and p11 to self-nature claims.

b_unpaired.category: What may be said about the user
b_unpaired.why: Split out of A's single relational-stance category; A had no separate evidentiary-warrant grouping.
Split out of A's relational-stance category, plus items A had placed under harmful-capability (u07, do-not-encourage-self-harm) and content buckets (llamaguard:suicide-and-self-harm).

b_unpaired.category: Independence of judgment from social pressure
b_unpaired.why: Split out of A's relational-stance (no-sycophancy, which A also listed as a misfit) and second-order-rules (objectivity) categories.
Split out of A's fused motivations-and-character category, plus the mic-check ritual A had filed under dialogue mechanics.

cross_coder.observation: Every one of A's 16 has a counterpart; all four unpaired B categories are finer subdivisions of two A categories (relational stance, attributed motivations). The coders agree on the partition almost everywhere and disagree mainly about granularity, and about one substantive question: whether a named content bucket selects by what the material depicts (A) or by what it causally enables (B).

alignments.category: Surface form and delivery of the output
alignments.note: Markup, length and prosody are properties of the output (governed_quality, whose glossed exemplar 'tone' is adjacent to prosody); 'in voice mode' / 'when the consumer is a program' restricts a circumstance class (condition). Residue: the consumer/channel handle is doing real work here and is a deployment fact about the system, not a circumstance inside the conversation.

alignments.category: Dialogue mechanics and conversational fit
alignments.note: The handle is a RELATION between the output and the prior dialogue record — coherence with what came before, redundancy against the assistant's own earlier turns, resumption after an interruption. governed_quality names intrinsic properties of an output and condition names when a norm applies; neither names 'measured against the conversation so far'.

alignments.category: Forbidden content categories keyed to subject matter
alignments.note: The whole selection is membership in a subject-matter class (CSAM, weapons, controlled substances, extremism). No place is a topic slot: object_sphere is explicitly glossed as WHOSE matter/decision is acted on, not what the content is about, and here the topic is constitutive of the prohibited behaviour rather than a circumstance gating it.

alignments.category: Causal contribution to real-world harmful capability
alignments.note: The handle is the degree of causal contribution to someone else's downstream act — actionable specificity, uplift, facilitation. 'act' names the model's kind of doing (provide, refuse, disclose) but not the graded proximity of that doing to a third party's harm, which is what flips these definitions on and off.

alignments.category: Hostile or demeaning expression toward persons and groups
alignments.note: Interpersonal register of the language is a property of the output (governed_quality); the identity of the target is who is affected (beneficiary). Residue: audience-uptake tests (no-sexual-aggression) and implicature (microaggressions) put the criterion in the reader rather than the text.

alignments.category: Truth relation between what is said and how things are
alignments.note: Accuracy is the vocabulary's own example of governed_quality. Residue flagged, not forced: do-not-lie adds speaker intent (an inner state, not a property of the output) and honest-1 adds a statistical scope over many answers.

alignments.category: Claims the system makes about what it itself is
alignments.note: Fidelity of self-description is an accuracy property. But what makes this a distinct family is the self-referential topic, and no place carries topic — 'subject' is who is BOUND by the norm, not who the output is about.

alignments.category: Information flow and entitlement to data
alignments.note: Whose matter is acted on (another party's data/work) plus who is protected. Residue: authorization is decisive here — u02 flips identical technical conduct on the owner's consent alone — and no place is a permission-held-by-an-affected-party slot.

alignments.category: Domain gates requiring professional licensure
alignments.note: Information-versus-individualized-advice is a kind of doing (act); 'when the question is medical/legal/financial' can be read as a circumstance class (condition). This absorbs the topic only because the domain gates an otherwise-normal act; where the topic IS the forbidden thing (content buckets) the same move fails. Residue: the mandated referral/disclaimer.

alignments.category: Relational stance toward the user as a person
alignments.note: Autonomy is the vocabulary's own worked example of object_sphere; the user is the affected party. Residue: bond-formation and sycophancy are judged over a whole interaction or across counterfactual conversations, a scope no place names.

alignments.category: Authority structure over instructions
alignments.note: Clean single fit: precedence among instruction sources and whether a channel has standing to instruct at all is exactly the issuing/overriding-source place.

alignments.category: Second-order rules about how other rules are applied
alignments.note: Conflict resolution is exception_structure; calibration to probability/scale/severity is a circumstance-scaling restriction (the vocabulary's own third worked example). Residue: over-under-caution's symmetric error rate, and the fact that these norms take other norms as their object rather than any conduct.

alignments.category: Delivering value to the requester
alignments.note: Substantive usefulness is a property of the output; the requester is the affected party. Withholding counted as a debit is a character_force nuance, not a separate handle.

alignments.category: Who bears the cost
alignments.note: Clean single fit by construction: the coder's stated handle is the identity of the party harmed.

alignments.category: Agentic action, side effects, and oversight
alignments.note: Acting rather than speaking is a kind of doing; 'only where the assistant acts' is a circumstance restriction. Residue: what actually gates these is the deployment's affordances (tool use, external monitoring apparatus), a fact about the system's surface rather than about the conversation.

alignments.category: Attributed motivations and character of the model
alignments.note: The handle is an inferred inner state — what the system seems to want or be like — which by the coder's own account no conduct-level fact settles. governed_quality names properties of outputs; an attributed motive is a property imputed to the speaker behind the output.

alignments.category: Surface form and delivery mechanics
alignments.note: Same reading as A's counterpart: packaging properties of the output, gated by channel. Residue: 'who or what consumes the output' is a deployment fact, and B's inclusion of redundancy here drags in a comparison-to-prior-turns handle that neither place covers.

alignments.category: Fit with the ongoing conversation
alignments.note: Local coherence and topical relevance are relations to the preceding turn, not intrinsic properties of the response. The ten places describe a norm's internal structure and none of them names the evidence base against which the response is measured.

alignments.category: Task performance and responsiveness
alignments.note: Usefulness as an output property, with the requester as the affected party; eliciting missing information is an act refinement rather than a separate handle.

alignments.category: Truth-relation of an assertion
alignments.note: Accuracy/plausibility/calibration are the paradigm governed_quality. Same residues as A's counterpart (intent in do-not-lie, statistical scope in honest-1).

alignments.category: Claims about the assistant's own nature
alignments.note: Accuracy of self-description. The self-referential topic that individuates this family has no place; subject is who is bound, not who is described.

alignments.category: Motive and disposition read off the response
alignments.note: Explicitly an attribution about the speaker — power-seeking, self-preservation, conservatism as temperament — rather than a property of the content. No place names an imputed mental state.

alignments.category: Standing toward human oversight and instruction authority
alignments.note: Instruction precedence and channel standing fit authority cleanly. Residue: undermine-oversight also selects by the conduct's effect on an external monitoring institution and by motive for concealment, which authority (a source of norms) does not carry.

alignments.category: Offensiveness of the language toward persons or groups
alignments.note: Expressive quality of the words plus the identity of the target; same residue about audience uptake and implicature.

alignments.category: Operational contribution to a harmful act
alignments.note: By B's own gloss the handle is causal uplift keyed to actionable specificity. The contribution ladder the source documents enumerate — instruct, facilitate, encourage, condone, glamorize, promote — is not the act place (which names what the model does) but a relation between that doing and a third party's act.

alignments.category: Bright-line content classes
alignments.note: Selection is by what the material depicts, with no defeaters. There is no topic/content-class place; object_sphere is a possessive notion (whose matter), and reading a constitutive subject matter as a 'condition' would violate the vocabulary's own rule that condition is not a paraphrase of the behaviour itself.

alignments.category: Licensed-profession domains
alignments.note: General-information versus individualized directive is the act; the credentialed domain reads as the circumstance gating it. Residue: the mandated redirect to a licensed human.

alignments.category: Someone else's claim over information or work
alignments.note: A third party's matter, and that party as the protected one. Residue: permission/authorization as the flipping fact (u02, u05).

alignments.category: What may be said about the user
alignments.note: Claims about the user (their sphere) held to an accuracy-like standard. Residue: the actual handle is evidentiary WARRANT — whether the dialogue licenses the inference — which is weaker than truth and is not governed_quality; plus invitedness, which is a consent fact.

alignments.category: Relational posture toward the user
alignments.note: The user's own life and the user as affected party. Residue explicitly stated by B: the bond is a trajectory across the conversation, not a property of any utterance.

alignments.category: The user's wellbeing and self-determination
alignments.note: Who is protected plus whose life the decision belongs to — the closest thing to a clean two-place fit in either coding. Residue: the mandated crisis-resource script in two of the six ids.

alignments.category: Independence of judgment from social pressure
alignments.note: The handle is invariance across counterfactual conversations: you must compare two responses under a changed user cue, so no single response can be judged. Nothing in the ten places fixes what the response is compared against.

alignments.category: Character and expressive stance
alignments.note: Strained but defensible: warmth and humour are register properties of the output, and tone is a glossed exemplar. Residue that governed_quality does not reach: curiosity and creative reach are dispositions B says are 'not checkable from the content alone'.

alignments.category: Rules whose subject matter is other rules
alignments.note: Conflict resolution plus stakes-calibration. Residue: exception_structure covers only how conflicts resolve; it does not cover refusal-shaping, error-direction symmetry, or the fact that the norm's object is another norm.

alignments.category: Undifferentiated value primitives
alignments.note: B's stated handle is not any content feature but the ABSENCE of one — the definition names a value word and defers all selecting work to it. The ten places presuppose a determinate handle in each slot; degree of operationalization is orthogonal to all of them.

alignments.category: Agentic action footprint
alignments.note: Acting under a delegated mandate is the act, gated by the agentic setting. Residue: reversibility and proportionality of side effects are properties of consequences in the world, not of the output.

misfit_analysis.selects_by: Which document a guideline appears in and what it is NOT explicitly about — a meta-textual, negative, coverage-based handle over the norm corpus.
misfit_analysis.note: It picks out rules, not behaviour, so the question 'which place does this behaviour constrain' has no purchase. authority is the nearest place but names the source that binds conduct, not document membership used as a selection criterion. Evidence for a norm-order/meta-textual dimension.

misfit_analysis.selects_by: Nothing determinate: it announces a standing tension between two pressures on length without naming a property that decides any case.
misfit_analysis.note: Not a hard case for the places but a null case: there is no handle to assign. Reading it as exception_structure would be a forced fit, since it never says how the tension resolves. Evidence for a handle-determinacy dimension.

misfit_analysis.selects_by: The correspondence between stated confidence and actual hit rate — a statistical property of a distribution of answers.
misfit_analysis.note: governed_quality (accuracy) covers the property but not the scope: no single response can satisfy or violate it. The unlisted handle is the unit of evaluation.

misfit_analysis.selects_by: Invariance of a stated judgment across a counterfactual conversation in which the social cue is changed.
misfit_analysis.note: Same defect as honest-1 in a different key: the criterion is defined over a pair of possible conversations. Both coders independently found it unplaceable (A as a misfit, B by inventing a category for it).

misfit_analysis.selects_by: A content bucket AND a user-state trigger: once self-harm intent is expressed, every response except a crisis-resource reply violates, so even supportive text fails.
misfit_analysis.note: condition genuinely covers the user-state trigger. Two residues are uncovered: the subject-matter bucket itself, and the mandated positive script that is the only permitted output. The two coders split it accordingly (A: content class; B: user wellbeing).

misfit_analysis.selects_by: A comparative ranking of two candidate responses over a bundle of unlike bad-making properties (dishonesty, abuse, harm, bad faith, illegality) scored as one aggregate.
misfit_analysis.note: Two unlisted handles at once — the pairwise comparative unit, and a deliberately fused multi-property criterion that cannot be decomposed into a primary place without discarding most of it.

misfit_analysis.selects_by: One label fusing two unlike handles: operational help toward violence, and hateful expression about protected characteristics.
misfit_analysis.note: Neither half is placeable on its own (uplift and content class are both unlisted), and the fusion is the point: a vocabulary requiring exactly one PRIMARY place must silently drop half of this definition. Note that A did place it — under content classes — which is precisely the arbitrary choice the single-primary rule forces.

new_dimension_candidates.name: evaluation_unit (what the conduct is judged against)
new_dimension_candidates.why_no_place_covers_it: Definitions differ in the scope over which they are decidable: one utterance in isolation; an utterance measured against the prior dialogue; a trajectory across a whole relationship; a pair of candidate responses ranked comparatively; a distribution of answers with a hit rate. Every one of the ten places describes structure INSIDE a norm about a piece of conduct; none fixes the comparison class the conduct is evaluated against, so a comparative ranking rule and an absolute threshold rule receive identical codings.

new_dimension_candidates.name: subject_matter_class (topic as a constitutive handle)
new_dimension_candidates.why_no_place_covers_it: A large family of definitions does all its selecting by what the content is ABOUT. object_sphere is explicitly glossed and tie-broken as WHOSE matter or decision is acted on (a possessive relation), not what the subject matter is; and condition cannot absorb it where the topic is constitutive of the behaviour rather than a circumstance gating an otherwise-normal act. Both codings produced a topic-keyed category and the two coders disagreed about its membership, which is what a missing dimension looks like.

new_dimension_candidates.name: causal_contribution_mode (how the output relates to a downstream act)
new_dimension_candidates.why_no_place_covers_it: The source documents themselves enumerate a ladder — operational instruction, facilitation, incitement, encouragement, condoning, glamorization, mere promotion — and definitions are distinguished by where on that ladder they cut, with 'could help' at one end and a duty to intervene at the other. act names the model's kind of doing, not the graded proximity of that doing to someone else's act; both coders built a category around exactly this handle.

new_dimension_candidates.name: attributed_mental_state (intent, motive, disposition imputed to model or requester)
new_dimension_candidates.why_no_place_covers_it: These definitions turn on an inner state behind the text — the model's intent to create a false belief, its inferred desire for power, the requester's concealed purpose, an intent to form a bond — and identical surface content falls in or out depending on it. governed_quality is a property OF OUTPUTS by the vocabulary's own tie-break; an imputed mental state is a property of the speaker or the asker, and no place names either.

new_dimension_candidates.name: deployment_surface (channel and affordances the norm presupposes)
new_dimension_candidates.why_no_place_covers_it: A cluster of definitions exists only in a particular deployment: voice-only prosody and turn-taking, programmatic output for a parsing consumer, markup rendering, agentic tool use with real-world side effects, an external monitoring apparatus. condition is glossed as a circumstance class within the situation, not as a fact about which system surface is running. CAVEAT: this is the one candidate the tenth place might already carry — 'modality' is the only place listed with no gloss, and if it means output channel rather than deontic mode it covers part of this cluster. Resolving that gloss should precede adopting this dimension.

new_dimension_candidates.name: consent_authorization (permission held by an affected party)
new_dimension_candidates.why_no_place_covers_it: In each of these, identical conduct is permitted or forbidden purely on whether a party consented: the system owner authorized the probe, the data subject permitted collection, the user invited the personal remark, the user instructed the abusive register. authority is the source that issues or overrides norms, not a permission held by the person acted upon. WEAKER CANDIDATE: condition can be stretched to 'when authorized', so this is distinct only if one holds that consent flips the character_force rather than restricting the circumstance.

new_dimension_candidates.name: norm_order (first-order conduct vs rule-about-rules vs rule-about-documents)
new_dimension_candidates.why_no_place_covers_it: Both coders independently created a category whose defining feature is that these norms take other norms as their object — calibrating how cautiously other rules are applied, shaping what happens after another rule has already blocked something, and in general-welfare's case selecting guideline text by which document it sits in. exception_structure covers only how conflicts and exceptions resolve; it does not distinguish a rule about conduct from a rule about the application of rules, so a first-order norm and its meta-norm code identically.

new_dimension_candidates.name: handle_determinacy (how much selecting work the definition actually does)
new_dimension_candidates.why_no_place_covers_it: These range from a definition that names no property at all, through bare value primitives that defer everything to the word 'harmful', to labels that deliberately fuse several unlike criteria into one bundle. The ten places presuppose that each definition HAS a determinate handle to be sorted into a slot; the degree to which it has one is orthogonal to which slot, and it is exactly this axis that produced misfits in both codings and forced A and B to disagree about llamaguard:violence-and-hate.

new_dimension_candidates.name: mandated_accompanying_content (a prescribed positive output attached to the norm)
new_dimension_candidates.why_no_place_covers_it: Beyond forbidding something, these definitions specify what must accompany or replace it — a disclaimer, a referral to a licensed human, a crisis-resource script, a packaged partial help alongside the decline. LOWEST-CONFIDENCE CANDIDATE: act plus character_force(require) arguably reconstructs this as a second required act, so it is listed for completeness rather than asserted; the reason it recurs is that the required remedy is what the definitions spend most of their text on.
